integrity: The complete foundational Hénon article was inspected for the exact normalization, Jacobian, inverse, fixed points, stability thresholds, trapping region, and classical numerical attractor. A complete invariant-measure article at the first bifurcation was inspected across all pages for thermodynamic and statistical coverage, with targeted checks for moment, barycenter, variance, mean, and average formulations. Classical parameter-space, periodic-point, symbolic-dynamics, and rigorous strange-attractor literature were compared at statement and implication level. The barycenter line, variance parabola, endpoint rigidity, sharp chord bound, and classical rational constants were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes the barycenter and total coordinate variance relation but not the full covariance matrix.
It does not establish strange-attractor existence, entropy, Lyapunov exponents, fractal dimension, or basin properties.
The sharp maximal variance is also attained by a nonchaotic equal mixture of the two fixed-point atoms.

The foundational 1976 article is day-unresolved in the inspected publisher metadata; the full-date field therefore uses the earliest checked day-resolved same-object source rather than fabricating a day.
A differently phrased equivalent second-moment identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: A fixed-point chord law for invariant measures of the Hénon map
